usedFor: Zoho Desk holds tickets, contacts and articles, and Algodocs receives a file through “Upload Document” when “New Attachment” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “New Attachment” in Zoho Desk, then “Upload Document” in Algodocs
bestTemplate.why: An attachment on a ticket is a file, and the action uploads a file by URL or Base64.

watchOut: “New Attachment” covers a selected organization, so check which one before “Upload Document” runs.
